meta.note: Series transcribed from GRFC 2026 Figure 2.7 (print p. 26); driver breakdown from section 2.4, Figures 2.5 (p. 22) and 2.6 (p. 25). Year-to-year comparisons are affected by changing country coverage: the 2026 edition covers 47 countries/territories, the lowest in a decade. Driver attribution assigns one PRIMARY driver per country context: the three 2025 populations sum to 264.7 million against the 265.7 million total, because GRFC excludes separately assessed displaced groups whose primary driver differs. The categories describe country-level attribution, not exclusive individual causes; drivers co-occur, and 31 countries reported economic shocks as an additional driver.
